benefits.title: Showtime and Price Questions Answered on the Spot
benefits.body: "What time is tonight's show?" "Any presale left?" "How much at the door?" The same questions arrive by the hundreds as an event approaches, and the closer the show, the less patient the asker. Cekat.AI answers instantly in natural language from your venue's knowledge base, so would-be guests get certainty and commit, instead of drifting to another night out.

benefits.body: Cekat.AI takes the ticket order inside the conversation, quantity, buyer details, and a payment QR, without sending guests to another app or an admin retyping orders into a spreadsheet. A guest goes from question to confirmed ticket in one chat, and every order lands complete and consistent.

Event inquiries came in over WhatsApp and were answered by hand: slow, inconsistent, often missing the detail a host needed to decide. After moving the home-service line onto Cekat.AI, every inquiry gets an instant, informative reply. The result: more leads handled, faster handling time, booking revenue roughly double the pre-AI baseline, and 2–4× during Lebaran, Christmas and New Year.

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help entertainment and event businesses?
faq.a: It works as your ticketing and event customer service system in one chat: answering showtimes, prices, and venue questions instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, selling tickets in conversation, and recording guest lists and table bookings automatically. Your team runs the show instead of answering the same chat all night.

faq.q: Can guests buy tickets straight from the chat?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI creates the ticket order from the conversation, quantity, buyer details, and a payment QR, without the guest ever leaving the chat. Orders land complete and consistent, and nothing gets retyped by hand.

faq.q: Can it handle guest lists and table bookings?
faq.a: Yes. Requests that arrive after midnight are answered and recorded by the AI on the spot, into a CRM card with the full chat history attached. Your door team opens a clean, complete list instead of scrolling through last night's DMs.

faq.q: What happens when an event is postponed or cancelled?
faq.a: Announce it first with a broadcast on the official WhatsApp Business API to the affected ticket holders, then the AI answers the refund and exchange questions that follow with one consistent answer based on your policy. Cases that need a judgment call escalate to your team with full context.

faq.q: Can the AI keep up when chats spike before a show?
faq.a: Yes. It answers every incoming chat instantly no matter how many arrive at once, so the hours before open gate stay fully covered. Response time doesn't queue, even when thousands ask at the same time.

WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat, all flowing into one inbox with a single history per guest. Someone who DMs on Instagram then continues on WhatsApp never repeats themselves.

faq.q: How long does setup take for a venue or promoter?
faq.a: Building the AI agent takes around five minutes, paste your show schedule, ticket prices, house rules, and SOPs into the knowledge base and it starts answering accurately. No coding required; as easy as briefing a new admin.

faq.q: What results have entertainment businesses seen?
faq.a: Puffy Cotton Candy took event and party bookings from manual replies to instant AI handling: booking revenue doubled, and 2–4× in peak season.

faq.q: Can we try it before committing?
faq.a: Yes. Book a free demo with our team, bring your own event scenarios, and watch the AI answer your guests' questions live. Pricing follows your channels and chat volume, and our team helps size the right plan.
